raw_reply: Encryption is like locking a message in a box so only people with the key can open it and read it. It changes the text into a scrambled form that looks random to anyone who doesn’t have the correct key to unlock it. This way, even if someone sees the scrambled message, they can’t understand it without the right key. It’s used to keep information safe, like when you send passwords or private notes online.

Una copia de seguridad es una copia de tus archivos o datos que puedes usar para restaurar tu sistema o información después de un error, pérdida o daño.  
En español: es como guardar un respaldo de tus cosas importantes, para que si algo sale mal, puedas volver a restaurarlas.  
En inglés: it’s a backup that lets you restore your system or files if something goes wrong.

Photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into chemical energy in the form of glucose.  
It occurs in the chloroplasts of plant cells, using carbon dioxide and water to produce oxygen and release energy.
